headerNotes.index: Batch sequence number; on letter rows, the entry's number within its batch.
headerNotes.name: Batch name (given when the letter stock was added). Empty on letter rows.
headerNotes.startNo: First YH number in the batch. Leading zeros are kept. On letter rows this and the next column are merged and hold the entry's YH number (or number range).
headerNotes.endNo: Last YH number in the batch. The start and end numbers are both part of the batch. Merged with the start column on letter rows.
headerNotes.total: Total YH letters in the batch. Sold + damaged + lost + left = total. On letter rows, how many of the entry's numbers fall inside the batch; they add up to the batch total.
headerNotes.status: Letter rows only: what happened to the entry — sold, damaged, lost, or used by a referral letter.
headerNotes.sold: Letters sold, including those given to referral letters. Filled on batch rows only.
headerNotes.damaged: Damaged (unusable) letters. Filled on batch rows only.
headerNotes.lost: Lost letters. Use this column's filter to see e.g. only the batches with lost letters.
headerNotes.remaining: Letters left (not used yet). Shown in grey when the batch is used up.
headerNotes.submittedBy: Letter rows only: the employee who submitted the letter.
headerNotes.receivedBy: Letter rows only: who received the letter.
headerNotes.date: On a batch row, the date the batch was added to the system; on a letter row, the entry's date.
headerNotes.note: Note written when the batch was added; on letter rows, the entry's note.
